title: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Can Be Unreliable in Implicit-Influence Settings
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitorability by applying contextual nudges to LLMs. These nudges explicitly include 'ethical' themes (such as animal welfare, worker rights, and environmental impact) to test how models handle and reason about these moral and ethical influences in their internal traces.
